newsitem.title: FRANCE: GBL takes BNP stake in Suez - paper.
newsitem.headline: GBL takes BNP stake in Suez - paper.

text.p: Groupe Bruxelles Lambert, controlled by Albert Frere, has bought a 3.05 percent stake in Cie de Suez, the Les Echos newspaper said on Friday.

The transaction would make GBL nearly the biggest shareholder in the merged group Suez-Lyonnaise des Eaux, almost equal to Credit Agricole, with a 7.22 percent stake, while the bank will have 7.6 percent.
The paper said BNP confirmed the sale of the 3.05 percent stake -- out of a total of five percent -- but declined to name the buyer.

The French stock market's association SBF said on Wednesday that a block of five million Suez shares, or 3.05 percent of the capital, had been traded off-market after close on Tuesday at a price of 285 francs per share or a total of 1.43 billion francs.
